resources.string: One key, this device, no account

A key is checked online once, when you enter it. From then on the server\'s signed certificate works offline until its time runs out — the app does not call home every time you open a screen. The certificate is bound to this device\'s random install id, so copying the app data to another phone does not carry the licence with it, and the owner can reset that binding from the panel if you change phones.
This key\'s time is over. A new key renews access.
Enter the key you received to unlock the paid surfaces.
Dashes and capitalisation do not matter — paste it as you received it.
Activated. This device is now linked to your key.
This key does not look complete. Check it and try again.
This build has no licence server configured.
No connection. The key is checked once, then works offline.

This key has reached its device limit. Ask for a device reset.
This device is not linked to the key yet. Activate it here first.

It is included with a key. One key covers this device, and entering it takes a minute.
